skill.name: github-token-utilities
skill.description: Audit, rotate and generate GitHub personal access tokens. Sets up and drives the github-token-utilities toolkit. Use whenever the user wants to create a GitHub token or PAT, find which repos hold token secrets like GH_TOKEN or GH_PAT, check for stale, expiring or invalid tokens, rotate or replace a repository Actions secret, install or update these token scripts, or mentions gen-gh-token, audit-gh-tokens or rotate-gh-token - even if they don't name the toolkit.
skill.compatibility: Requires Node.js 22+, git, and the GitHub CLI (gh) authenticated to github.com. Works on macOS, Linux and Windows; bash, zsh, sh, ksh, dash, fish, csh/tcsh and PowerShell.
skill.shortDescription: Audit, rotate and generate GitHub tokens
skill.author: agentic-incubator
